subject: [PATCH 51/60] mm: restrict explicit migration to N_MEMORY_MEMPOLICY

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch introduces a new function `folio_allows_mempolicy()` and uses it instead of the existing logic. It also updates cpuset migration to evacuate private memory only from nodes no longer allowed by the cpuset.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch restricts explicit memory migration to nodes that permit memory policy (N_MEMORY_MEMPOLICY), allowing userspace NUMA operations to target these nodes. It introduces a new function `folio_allows_mempolicy()` and uses it instead of the existing logic. The patch also updates cpuset migration to evacuate private memory only from nodes no longer allowed by the cpuset.
